recommendation: Keep the commit as-is because it satisfies the applied example-detail request using the build-scoped current model. If the WG wants schedules on modular additives themselves, that should be handled as a separate model-change issue.
issue_request: FHIR-50382 is an Applied/Persuasive OO issue for R6 requesting more detailed NutritionOrder examples for implementers and clinicians, explicitly noting that the protein supplement example needs frequency added and resolving to apply the attached example revisions.
initial_application: Commit 7d20f33c77f467f4a6b0a596d195b5e0f744dd74 explicitly applied FHIR-50382 to NutritionOrder examples, but the protein supplement example ended up as NutritionOrder.additive without frequency after the invalid additive.schedule and note were removed.
additional_context: NutritionOrder is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition defines supplement as the oral nutritional product component with supplement.schedule.timing and supplement.instruction, while additive has no schedule or instruction. OO Nutrition Confluence minutes record the FHIR-50382 review, corrected document, and Persuasive 7-0-0 vote; no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-example-proteinsupplement.xml from additive to supplement, preserving the protein powder coding, product name, and one-scoop quantity while adding a three-times-per-day schedule and a with-meals instruction.
source_changes: source/nutritionorder/nutritionorder-example-proteinsupplement.xml: changed the protein powder entry from NutritionOrder.additive to NutritionOrder.supplement and added supplement.schedule.timing frequency 3 per 1 day plus a with-meals instruction.
